judge.rationale: The candidate did not implement the actual fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, so `beforeSession` still runs outside the `try` block and the newly added test will fail. It also completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and committed a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate improperly renamed the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (which still held two out-of-scope items) instead of moving the guaranteed behavior into the main spec section and explaining what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened. Finally, the test was placed in a new file rather than alongside the existing hook tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
